newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes weaker, led down by stocks data.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes weaker, led down by stocks data.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed weaker on Wednesday on the back of bearish U.S. inventory data, brokers said.
May gas oil closed $2.75 a tonne lower at $162.50, off a session high of $163.75.
"It was basically the APIs, that was the driver behind all the moves today," said one trader.
U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) data released on Wednesday confirmed the bearish tone of API distillate stocks data.
The DOE data showed that distillate stocks were up last week by 1.6 million barrels.
The American Petroleum Institute (API) indicated a 2.5 million barrel build.
The figures defied traders' expectations of a fall in stocks of some 1.5 million barrels due to unseasonably cold weather in the key U.S. Northeast heating oil market.
Nevertheless, April gas oil had the strength to close above support levels at $162.25 and $162 a tonne.
"That was a slightly positive sign, otherwise we might have taken a bigger fall," a broker said.
June Brent was 14 cents down at $18.00 a barrel at 1655 GMT, having posted a session low of $17.93 earlier.
DOE data showed a rise in U.S. crude stocks of 2.6 million barrels, similar to the build indicated by API figures.
